info.title: API.SH: Fotocasa
info.description: The Fotocasa API from API.SH: public Fotocasa data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The listings of one Fotocasa agency (its clientId), with the same filters and fields as /fotocasa/v1/search, plus the agency's name, logo, page and phone. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotocasa-agency

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agency clientId (advertiser.id in search results, or the number in an agency link).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Fotocasa listing: reference, title, operation, type and subtype, price and price drop, rooms, bathrooms, area and land area, every feature (orientation, floor, heating, hot water, condition, lift, furnished...), extras, energy certificate ratings, description, creation date, new-build, occupancy and auction flags, address with coordinates, all photos and videos, and the advertiser (agency name, logo, page, website and phone; a private seller's phone is left out). Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotocasa-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number before /d in the link), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotocasa-places

parameters.description: Operation the places are suggested for.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Fotocasa's housing price index for a municipality: median and mean sale price per m², rent per m², 1/3/6/12-month changes, market temperature, the monthly sale and rent price history, every district's prices and changes, and nearby municipalities.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotocasa-price-index

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Municipality slug, or a fotocasa.es/indice-precio-vivienda link (in `url`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A fotocasa.es/indice-precio-vivienda link instead of location.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes and other property in Spain on Fotocasa with the site's filters: operation (buy, rent, share, holiday rental, rent-to-buy, transfer), property type, place, price, rooms, bathrooms, area, condition, new or second-hand, features (pool, terrace, lift, parking...), publication date and sort. Each result has id, link, type, operation, price and price drop, rooms, bathrooms, area, floor and other features, description, date, address with coordinates, photos with room type, the advertiser (agency name, logo, page and phone; a private seller's phone is left out) and new-development typologies. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotocasa-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name in Spain (city, district, province...); the best match is used. Or give `location_id`.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition, comma-separated: new, almost_new, very_good, good, to_renovate, renovated.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Required features, comma-separated: pool, terrace, lift, private_garage, garden, air_conditioning, balcony, storage_room, furnished, not_furnished, pets_allowed, sea_views, central_heating, porter, security, community_pool, equipped_kitchen, ...

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: Published within the last day, 2days, week or month.

parameters.name: subtype_ids
parameters.description: Fotocasa property subtype ids, comma-separated (e.g. 1 flat, 6 penthouse...).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
